meaning: Land-manager documented visitor arrival and parking policy. Not a confirmation that a road or lot is open or plowed on a future travel day.

gooseberry-upper.arrivalName: Gooseberry Falls Visitor Center / DOT Wayside lot
gooseberry-upper.arrivalAddress: 3206 Highway 61 East, Two Harbors, MN 55616, USA
gooseberry-upper.winterParkingText: Minnesota DNR's winter map directs visitors to park at the visitor center and use the short accessible Upper Falls approach. It does not guarantee a space or report today's lot conditions.
gooseberry-upper.parkingFeeText: No state park vehicle permit is required at the Visitor Center / DOT Wayside lot.
gooseberry-upper.parkingNotes: Use the visitor-center parking area. Other park lots have different permissions and maintenance; ice cleats are recommended on trails.

munising-snowshoe.arrivalName: Pictured Rocks Ski Trail Parking Lot at East City Limits Road
munising-snowshoe.arrivalAddress: East City Limits Road, east of Munising, Michigan, USA
munising-snowshoe.winterParkingText: NPS directs snowshoers to the ski trail parking lot near the end of East City Limits Road, then a short walk to the blue-post loop. The NPS official Snowshoe Trail page identifies the trail parking lots as plowed in winter.
munising-snowshoe.parkingFeeText: Check the official park fee information before the trip; this evidence does not establish a parking fee exemption.
munising-snowshoe.parkingNotes: Do not substitute roads deep inside the park: most park roads are unplowed in winter. The parking description is a seasonal policy, not today's snowplow report.

meyers-lakeshore.arrivalName: Meyers Beach Parking Area / Lakeshore Trailhead
meyers-lakeshore.arrivalAddress: 90500 Meyers Beach Road, Bayfield, WI 54814, USA
meyers-lakeshore.winterParkingText: NPS identifies the Meyers Beach parking area and Lakeshore Trail entrance at 90500 Meyers Beach Road. Winter plowing and current road access have not been established from the source. Severe-weather closures may include Meyers Beach.
meyers-lakeshore.parkingFeeText: NPS lists a day-use parking fee at Meyers Beach; check the official Fees & Passes page for current amounts and payment instructions.
meyers-lakeshore.parkingNotes: Vehicle length may not exceed 45 feet. The route stays above the sandstone cliffs; park access is not authorization to walk onto Lake Superior ice.
